scripts.parity: node tests/parity/capture.mjs --base http://localhost:3100 --out parity-capture && node tests/parity/compare.mjs --captured parity-capture

budget.next: App framework and routing; the same major as the old tree, pinned exact (16.4.2 closes the 16.1.6 advisories of npm audit).
budget.react: UI runtime required by next; pinned to the old tree's 19.2.3.
budget.react-dom: DOM renderer required by next; pinned to the old tree's 19.2.3.
budget.@supabase/supabase-js: The one database and auth client for the user client and the service client.
budget.@supabase/ssr: Cookie-backed session for the user client in server components and route handlers.
budget.zod: Request and payload validation at every boundary (src/core/http/parse.ts); the old tree had no validator.
budget.eslint-config-next: Next lint rules; bundles the typescript-eslint and import plugins, so no separate plugin is added. Held at 16.2.12 while next is 16.4.2: from 16.3.0 its plugin adds no-location-assign-relative-destination, which warns on five window.location navigations in src/ and fails the zero-warning lint; moving to 16.4.2 waits on those five call sites.
budget.@types/node: Node types for scripts and next.config.ts.
budget.undici: The Agent whose connect lookup returns the address the guard vetted (audit 2.3.14): Node's global fetch accepts it as a dispatcher, and the built-in cannot be constructed without the package.
budget.unpdf: PDF text extraction (pdf.js, serverless build) for the direct transport, held-pool reads and the mint capture; the Edge Function loads its own copy via npm: specifier.
budget.zustand: Client state stores (workspace identity, per-item state, dashboard settings) that the shell and every surface read, and the admin source registry filter (features/sources/store.ts); the same major as the old tree.
budget.playwright: headless transport on the Actions runner and the parity gate; never bundled (dynamic import, browser installed only on the runner).
budget.react-markdown: The one markdown renderer (GfmSection) for the fact documents and briefs; sanitises by construction, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
budget.remark-gfm: GFM tables for GfmSection (the briefs carry tables).
budget.@tanstack/react-query: The one QueryClient for the list surface remainder fetch (use-list-rows) and the shell; the old tree used it for the same.
budget.@tanstack/react-virtual: Row virtualization for a long list surface (a 1,300-row corpus); the old ledger used it.
budget.leaflet: The Regulations map (src/features/regulations/map/MapView.tsx): tiles, count-sized markers, fly-to; loaded only on the /map route; OpenStreetMap attribution shown (react-leaflet is not added: one effect drives the map).
budget.@types/leaflet: Types for leaflet under the strict typecheck.
budget.embedded-postgres: A throwaway PostgreSQL 15 for npm run schema:local, so the schema job runs on a workstation without Docker or a system Postgres (devDependency; never bundled).
budget.pg: The one SQL client of the CI scripts (scripts/ci/psql.mjs): CI and a workstation run the same code, with no psql binary (devDependency; never bundled).
budget.yaml: Parses .github/workflows/*.yml in the gates (IMP-100), so a malformed workflow is refused at the hook instead of producing a "workflow file issue" red (devDependency; never bundled).
budget.supabase: The Supabase CLI the edge-deploy job runs (functions list, functions deploy), pinned exact so the lockfile covers it; its platform binary arrives as an optional dependency, so no install script is needed (devDependency; never bundled).
budget.actionlint: Lints .github/workflows/*.yml in the gates (scripts/ci/workflow-yaml.mjs): unknown needs, bad expressions and contexts, schema errors, which the YAML parser cannot see and which produce "workflow file issue" reds (the project's own wasm build, exact version; devDependency, never bundled).
